description: Find current theatre, dance, music, and other cultural events in Sofia and across Bulgaria. Search by date, city, venue, title, or performer, then review venue details, cast, editorial context, and public theatre or event information pages. SofiaStage is read-only: it cannot book tickets, initiate checkout or payment, access accounts or favorites, or guarantee availability.

defaultPrompt: Find up to five Sofia cultural events in the next seven days, with local date and time, venue, city, and stable ID.
